raw_snippet: Amazon agreed to invest up to $50 billion in the startup, Nvidia invested $30 billion, and SoftBank invested $30 billion
dispute_text: Reported (OpenAI announcement via CNBC), not in an Nvidia filing: the FY26 10-K says only 'finalizing an investment and partnership agreement with OpenAI'; the Q2 FY27 10-Q does not name the amount.
note: Nvidia -> OpenAI equity in the US$122B round (closed 31 Mar 2026); Amazon US$50B and SoftBank US$30B in the same round.
